name: Chicken Corn Soup
description: A creamy and comforting soup with chicken and corn.
instructions: Cook chicken and corn in water until tender.
Thicken with cornflour slurry, add beaten egg.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper, serve hot.

name: Lentil Soup
description: A hearty and nutritious lentil soup with spices.
instructions: Boil lentils with chopped tomato and spices.
Blend or serve chunky, adjust seasoning with salt.
Serve with a drizzle of oil.

name: Mutton Yakhni
description: A flavorful mutton broth with aromatic spices.
instructions: Boil mutton bones with spices and onion.
Simmer for 2-3 hours, strain broth.
Serve hot with a pinch of salt.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: A light soup with mixed vegetables.
instructions: Chop vegetables, boil with water and cumin.
Add butter, season with salt.
Serve warm.

name: Tomato Soup
description: A tangy and smooth tomato-based soup.
instructions: Boil tomatoes and onion, blend into a puree.
Add ginger, cream, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot.

name: Haleem Soup
description: A thick soup made with lentils, wheat, and meat.
instructions: Cook mutton, lentils, and wheat together until soft.
Blend into a thick consistency, add garam masala.
Garnish with fried onions and ghee, serve hot.

name: Spinach Soup
description: A healthy soup with fresh spinach.
instructions: Boil spinach and potato with garlic.
Blend into a smooth soup, add cream.
Season with salt, serve warm.

name: Paya Soup
description: A rich soup made from slow-cooked trotters.
instructions: Boil paya with spices and onion for 4-5 hours.
Strain broth, season with salt.
Serve hot.

name: Mixed Dal Soup
description: A blend of lentils for a nutritious soup.
instructions: Cook both dals with tomato and cumin.
Blend or serve as is, adjust salt.
Serve with a tadka of ghee.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
description: A creamy mushroom soup with a Pakistani twist.
instructions: Sauté mushrooms in butter, add milk.
Simmer until thick, season with pepper and salt.
Serve hot.
